text:
elena: Heads-up — I need a compact manager-first-week + 30/60/90 checklist tailored for hybrid hires. New PM starts next Mon. Need something I can DM to hiring managers and attach to the Notion onboarding page by EOD. Key stuff I think we need: laptop pickup window, remote image + VPN access, buddy assignment, first-week intro 1:1s, desk/parking logistics. Any must-add items?
dina: I'll pull our standard packet and strip it down to a 1-page manager checklist. For hybrid, add: office meetup plan, desk/monitor checklist, building access & parking pass step, and a note about reimbursing travel if needed.
marco: IT note: schedule laptop pickup slot and pre-stage the image the day before. We usually push image tag `rwi-onboard-2026-v2`. For remote folks we ship same-day with express label. Quick runbook snippet to include for managers:```bash
# IT will run this when creating account
./onboard_new_user.sh --email {email} --team {team} --role {role}
```
sam: Also recommend adding a short "first 30-day expectations" template managers can copy into their first 1:1: 3 deliverables, 2 learning goals, weekly sync cadence, and a 30-day check-in with career growth/OKR alignment. I have a 30/60/90 doc I can share — will paste a stripped version.
onboard-bot: Reminder: new hires must be enrolled in security-training and SSO setup before first day. People Ops will auto-invite to #security-training and #new-hires once manager fills the quick intake form.
mira: small question from hiring manager — where do we put "office meetup" details? Should manager book a breakfast or just a 30-min desk walkthrough?
elena: Good q. Recommend: quick 30-min desk/setup walkthrough on day 1 + optional team breakfast (manager decides). Add a bullet: "Manager schedules 30-min desk/setup with IT or buddy." Also include a line: "If hybrid hire is remote-first for week 1, schedule virtual welcome + shipping confirmation."
dina: I'll add an RSVP checkbox for breakfast and an "is travel reimbursement needed" field to the intake form. Also adding a short template managers can DM to new hire on day 0 with pickup times and parking details. :thumbsup:
marco: For pickup logistics: IT window Mon 9–11am (building A, 3rd floor). If manager wants imaging earlier, we can push image on Fri 5pm. Shipping option: UPS overnight — include shipping address field on intake.
elena: Perfect. Can everyone review the one-pager before 4pm? I'll compile Dina's stripped packet, Sam's 30/60/90 bullets, and Marco's IT windows into one shareable doc. If all good I'll post to Notion under Onboarding > Manager Checklists and ping #people-ops.
sam: +1 — I'll DM my 30/60/90 template after lunch.
mira: Thanks! I'll forward the parking lot map and where to redeem visitor pass to the hiring manager.
onboard-bot: Action items created: 1) Update intake form, 2) Publish manager one-pager, 3) Create calendar template — assigned to dina, elena, marco. Due: today 4:00pm.
